FR-001.title: Present Load sample data on the Organisation Settings tab instead of Review

FR-002.title: Review tab shows sample-data choice read-only, not as a checkbox

FR-003.title: Sample data selected disables Chart of Accounts, Opening Balances, Committee tabs

FR-004.title: Next skips the three bypassed tabs when sample data is selected

FR-005.title: Finish does not require Chart of Accounts/balance/committee data when sample data selected

FR-006.title: Checking sample data discards already-queued account/balance/committee entries

FR-007.title: Unchecking sample data re-enables the three tabs, starting empty

FR-008.title: Debug seeder must already cover accounts/balances/committee data it bypasses

context: living spec: app-host (capabilities/app-host/spec.md — Optional sample-data seeding section)
area: src/StageFright.UI/Pages/Setup/ (SetupWizard.razor(.cs), Tabs/ReviewTab, Tabs/GeneralAppearanceTab, Tabs/ChartOfAccountsTab, Tabs/OpeningBalancesTab, Tabs/CommitteeTab)
constraint: spec 017's existing rule — Finish requires a posted opening balance OR sample data selected — preserved unchanged (FR-005)
constraint: this feature is scoped to the /setup first-run wizard only; standalone Chart of Accounts, Opening Balances, and Settings pages are unaffected
intent: Let a coordinator decide up front (on the Organisation Settings tab) whether to load sample data, and skip manual Chart of Accounts, Opening Balances, and Committee entry entirely when they do.
expectations: Standalone Finance ▸ Chart of Accounts and Opening Balances pages, and the Settings page's post-setup committee configuration, are out of scope — unchanged.
Release-build behavior (no debug seeder registered) is unchanged — the checkbox and its bypass never appear.
No new entities, services, or database schema changes — this is wizard-navigation and in-session-queue behavior only.
approach: Add a new SampleDataTab sub-component to the Organisation Settings tab (moving the existing checkbox markup as-is), bind BlazorBootstrap's native Tab.Disabled to _seedWithTestData on the three affected tabs with a code-level SetActiveTab guard as backup, and make HandleNextAsync skip past disabled tabs; checking the box clears the three in-session queues.

decisions.decision: Use BlazorBootstrap Tab.Disabled + a SetActiveTab code guard to bypass the three tabs
decisions.why: Tab.Disabled already exists on the installed 3.5.0 package (confirmed via reflection) and matches prefer-existing-patterns guidance; the code guard makes FR-003 hold regardless of library click-suppression internals
decisions.rejected: CSS-only disabling with no functional guard; conditionally removing <Tab> elements from the DOM (breaks positional indexing)

decisions.decision: New SampleDataTab.razor/.razor.cs component reusing ReviewTabs existing checkbox markup unchanged (plain form-check, not RadzenSwitch)
decisions.why: matches the Organisation Settings tabs existing one-sub-component-per-concern decomposition; restyling was never asked for by issue #313
decisions.rejected: inlining the markup into SetupWizard.razor; converting to RadzenSwitch while relocating

decisions.why: source inspection confirms the seeder already creates chart-of-accounts entries, a full opening-balance position, and elects a full committee across two AGMs
decisions.rejected: n/a - verification, not a design choice; tasks.md still carries a verification task per the specs own instruction

plan.summary: Plan complete: SampleDataTab component, Tab.Disabled-driven bypass with a code guard, Next-skip, queue-clear-on-check; FR-008 verified needing no seeder changes.
plan.key_finding: BlazorBootstrap 3.5.0 Tab already exposes a Disabled bool parameter (confirmed via assembly reflection), avoiding any custom CSS/JS for tab unavailability.
